visual.general_description: Five grayscale coronal abdominal CT images labelled (A) to (E); (A) to (D) each carry three yellow arrows pointing at round black gas collections on the image left, and (E) has no arrows.
visual.detailed_description: Five coronal grayscale CT images are laid out with (A) at the left and (B) and (C) above (D) and (E) at the right, each labelled below in parentheses. Panels (A) to (D) show round black gas-filled areas in bowel on the image left, each marked by three yellow arrows, with the clustered gas collections largest in (B) and fewer and smaller in (C) and (D). Panel (E) has no arrows and shows no large round black gas-filled clusters.

panels.general_description: Smaller grayscale coronal abdominal CT image with three yellow arrows pointing at gas-filled round areas of the bowel.
panels.detailed_description: Panel label (A) printed below the image. A coronal grayscale CT slice, smaller and more contrasted than the other panels, showing the liver at upper left, bright rib and bone cross-sections and the soft tissue of the abdominal wall. In the lower abdomen on the image left there are many round black gas-filled areas of varying size clustered within a bowel segment. Three yellow arrows point at this region: two at the upper edge of the cluster, near the liver margin, and one lower pointing up and to the left toward the middle of the cluster.

Labels above the line read Initial presentation at Day -215, Hospital admission at Day 0, Ear tube placement at Day 21 and Hospital discharge at Day 26. Vertical lines drop from the timeline at Day 0, Day 2, Day 24, Day 26 and Day 34. Below the line, gray horizontal bars carry the labels Bowel rest, Sorbitol free diet, Metronidazole intravenous, Metronidazole oral, 2 liters per minute low flow oxygen via nasal cannula and Daily hyperbaric oxygen therapy. The bowel rest and intravenous metronidazole bars run from Day 0 to about Day 2, the diet and oral metronidazole bars from about Day 2 to Day 26, the oxygen bar from Day 0 to Day 26 and the hyperbaric oxygen bar from about Day 24 to Day 34. No patient names, dates or panel letters are printed.
